title: Blade OML angular position, hub A datum to blade OML, at the -5 deg worst-case sensitivity (degrees)

provenance.the_transform_demonstration: This is the study that crosses the linear-rotary coupling. `pitch_arm_link_hole_to_clocking_hole` is absent from the map above because it carries the coupling as its OWN default (`blade_root_tangential_to_rotary`, the sheet's D11) -- the conversion there is the pitch arm's geometry, not this study's choice. Every other edge is a vertical contributor and gets the vertical sensitivity (D10) assigned here. That is what the source sheet does to the six of them it has a linear row for (B43, B44, B39, B38, B37, B31 -> D43, D44, D39, D38, D37, D31, each B x D10). The other three carry `assumed` placeholder bands: two (`hub_top_deck_to_vpa_mount`, `vpa_mount_to_end_stop_feature`) have no row in the sheet at all, and the third, `blade_root_clocking_to_oml`, is the exception worth reading -- the sheet's row 22 states 0.181 deg directly and multiplies nothing, so applying D10 to that edge's stand-in millimetre band is this study's construction and not the sheet's. See that edge's own source note. Two different sensitivities, one output unit, one fold.
provenance.method_is_the_source_sheet's: Converting every contributor into one common output quantity before summing is the source workbook's own method (its D and F columns), and it is the reason its raw-millimetre B-column total is not a physically meaningful number -- WORKSHEET_end_stop_graft.md section 2f. summarize() refuses to add millimetres to degrees rather than reproducing that.
provenance.not_a_result: Every ratio and most bands here are placeholders. The number this study produces is a demonstration that the arithmetic wires up, not an angular tolerance for the pitch system.

notes: A sensitivity is a property of the STUDY's output quantity, not of the edge alone: the same pitch-plate millimetre is worth a different number of degrees depending on which quantity is being rolled up, which is why the source sheet has three sensitivity columns over one set of rows. So an edge's default transform stays identity unless the conversion is intrinsic to the part (the pitch arm), and a study declares the rest.

The subset this covers is the brief's named vertical path plus the two blade-root edges that reach the OML. It is not the source sheet's 43 rows and does not reproduce that sheet's totals -- see the topology's notes for the two mechanisms (a diameter-MMC weighting factor, and a backlash derived from a radial clearance) that v0 cannot express.
